paragraphs.html: Entry to the parking garage is on 7th St between Colorado and Congress on the right side of the road.
We are located on the corner of 6th and Congress. Use the entrance on Congress and head to the building security desk on the ground floor where they can let you up to the 24th floor.
Once you enter the building from the garage, check in with building security.

cards.title: Photo ID
cards.body: Please bring your government ID/passport with you, so our security team can confirm your identity.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the provided link.
cards.note: All candidates are required to sign in order to begin their interview. If you have any questions regarding the NDA form, please reach out to your Recruiting Coordinator.

cards.title: Arrival & departure
cards.body: Someone will lead you up to the 24th floor where you will sign in with Box reception.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
